data.title: Atlantis The Royal Residences
data.about:
Atlantis The Royal Residences, located on the Crescent of Palm Jumeirah, is a landmark development by Kerzner International, completed in 2023. The iconic structure houses 1,026 exquisitely designed units, offering 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom homes, including luxurious suites, signature penthouses, sky courts, and townhouses. Every residence is crafted with refined finishes, panoramic sea views, and private terraces or pools.

Residents enjoy privileged access to world-class amenities, including private beaches, infinity pools, a wellness center, and over 17 world-class restaurants and bars curated by celebrity chefs. The design is a striking blend of contemporary elegance and oceanic inspiration, setting a new standard for luxury living in Dubai. Atlantis The Royal Residences redefines opulence on Palm Jumeirah’s most prestigious address.

characteristics_module.title: Live Beyond Luxury with Unmatched Elegance and World-Class Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Location on Palm Jumeirah – Situated on the prestigious Crescent, Atlantis The Royal Residences offers breathtaking views and unrivaled access to Dubai’s most exclusive waterfront.
  • Masterfully Crafted by Kerzner International – Developed by the visionaries behind world-renowned resorts, ensuring exceptional quality and attention to detail.
  • Exclusive Collection of Luxury Residences – Choose from 1,026 bespoke homes including suites, penthouses, townhouses, and sky courts designed for the elite.
  • World-Class Amenities at Your Doorstep – Enjoy private beaches, infinity pools, wellness facilities, and fine dining from Michelin-starred chefs.

location_tile.title: Elite Island Living with Seamless Access Across Dubai
location_tile.description:
Atlantis The Royal Residences is strategically situated on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, offering residents unparalleled access to Dubai's key destinations. The development is well-connected via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Dubai's main arterial highway, facilitating convenient travel to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. This prime location ensures that residents can effortlessly enjoy the vibrant lifestyle and attractions that Dubai has to offer.

  • 03 mins – Atlantis, The Palm
  • 15 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 18 mins – JBR | Mall of Emirates | Burj Al Arab
  • 24 mins – Downtown Dubai | Burj Khalifa
  • 28 mins – Dubai International Airport
